about_the_game:
Defend Earth with incredible space shield system — and help Make Space Great Again!

Donald has built the most tremendous defense system the world has ever seen: two protective shields to protect our planet from incoming asteroids. One big, one small — and your task is to control them both using only two buttons. Quick reflexes, perfect timing, and strategic thinking are your keys to victory.

Asteroids are coming fast, and the evil communist space dictators won’t stop until the planet is destroyed. Can you keep Earth safe and rack up the highest scores ever seen? It’s fast, it’s funny, and it’s going to be YUGE.

We made arcade great again!

This is the most incredible tribute, a truly beautiful and absolutely unbelievable homage to the golden age of arcade gaming. Back when machines were strong, powerful, made of real steel, and players were tougher, smarter, and totally unstoppable. Everybody wanted that glorious Hi-Score, the best score, maybe the greatest score ever. M.Y.DO.N.G. brings it all back with style, passion, and winning energy like you’ve never seen before. It’s bigger, it’s better, it’s more amazing than anyone thought possible. Believe me folks, nobody makes arcade greatness like we do. We made arcade great again!

Key Features:

  • Simple controls, deep gameplay: Only two buttons, but endless possibilities.

  • Two shields to command: The big shield rotates counterclockwise, the small shield clockwise — use them wisely!

  • Endless asteroids: Test your reflexes and timing as the challenge keeps ramping up.

  • Donald-flavored humor: Enjoy the tongue-in-cheek story and over-the-top parody dialogue.

  • Make Space Great Again: Save Earth, protect Donald’s power, and become the hero the galaxy deserves.

  • Score-chasing fun: Compete with yourself or your friends for the ultimate high score.

  • Fast-paced, arcade-style action: Quick thinking and fast fingers are rewarded.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: Two space shields. Two buttons. Endless asteroids. Defend Earth from evil communist space dictators with Donald’s “YUGE” space shield system. Fast, funny, and packed with asteroid-blasting humor.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal
